objectives:
Course Objective :
(課程目標)
◎Learners will understand and build critical thinking and problem solving skills.
◎Learners will be able to apply their business management theories to practice.
◎Learners will be able to take the challenges from the shifting global social, legal, economic, political, and technological conditions.
◎Learners will know the importance and the effective strategies of environmental stewardship.
◎Learners will be able to express personal opinions and interact with each other in the target language and make effective oral communications.

Course Description and Format:
This is a course devoted to developing learners’ Business English skills of listening and speaking. The topics selected from the textbook can be of interest to them. Other timely, authentic and insightful materials chosen from different sources will also be selected to provide opportunities for discussions and personalized practices in class.
Learners will practice English through a series of collaborative activities, such as participating in group discussion and pair discussion, role-playing, presenting individual reports as well as team projects. The purpose of all the activities is to promote the development of the linguistic skills which students need to succeed in business communication.
